summary: Full integration test of TASCK OS v3.2 backend (/api/v3/*) + new admin Business Cases pages. 16/16 backend pytest cases PASS. All 4 frontend scenarios PASS (BC list with live metrics + 12 BCs, NB flagship detail with tabs/deliver/scope-creep banner/scope-change log, OSF Grant detail with 'Grant — TTA pays creator directly' pill and no SDF section, CRM with 11 brands + live badge + Paid/Grant pills). No regressions on /v3/admin and /v3/admin/projects.

issues: Stage/Track filter tab groups render correctly and are clickable (All/Connect/Frame/Plan/Deliver/Closed + All tracks/Paid/Grant) but the wrapper containers do not expose data-testid='bc-filter-stage' or 'bc-filter-track' as requested in the spec. Individual filter buttons appear to lack data-testid too. Non-blocking for users, but recommended for testability.

feature_test_results.GET /api/v3/business-cases (>=5 seeded): PASS — 5 seeded + a few test BCs created by pytest

feature_test_results.POST brainstorm-rounds auto-eliminates c: PASS — Wizkid (cb=2) and Boy Spyce (cb=1) eliminated with correct reason

feature_test_results.Frontend /v3/admin/business-cases/bc-nb-: PASS — bc-tabs present, all 5 tab data-testids (connect/frame/plan/deliver/closure), 'Delivery paused — scope change pending brand approval' banner visible, 'Detty December' bonus scope change in log
feature_test_results.Frontend /v3/admin/business-cases/bc-osf: PASS — 'GRANT — TTA PAYS CREATOR DIRECTLY' pill, Frame tab shows 'Strategy Development Fee is waived' / 'no Strategy Development Fee issued (Grant track)'
feature_test_results.Frontend /v3/admin/crm 11 brands + live: PASS — crm-live-badge present, 11 crm-track-pill-* (10 Paid + 1 Grant for OSF)

action_items: (Optional/Low priority) Expose data-testid='bc-filter-stage' and 'bc-filter-track' on the filter group containers on /v3/admin/business-cases for testing reliability — visible UI already works.
critical_code_review_comments: Seed is idempotent only on empty collections — once a deliverable is transitioned in a prior dev session it stays advanced, so any test that hardcodes a starting status (e.g. del-nb-5 pending_upload) will be brittle. Fixed in test by dynamically selecting first non-approved deliverable.

/api/v3/business-cases/{id}/advance returns HTTPException(400, {'errors':[...]}) — the dict is wrapped under 'detail' by FastAPI which is fine, but a consistent error envelope would help frontend rendering.
Frontend filter chips on Business Cases list are functional but lack the data-testid attributes that other testable elements have — minor testability gap.

AI alignment endpoint returns the existing snapshot if one already exists (idempotent generate) — good. However the response in that branch is the raw stored doc, while a freshly generated doc returns the same shape so this is consistent.
v3_routes.py uses dict-spread {**d} when inserting docs to avoid mutating seeds — good defensive pattern.
test_credentials: Not required — /select role cards bypass auth for /v3/admin/*
seed_data_creation: pytest created a handful of TEST_ prefixed BCs (TEST_New BC from pytest, TEST_Override advance, TEST_Alignment paid, TEST_Alignment grant, TEST_Brainstorm) — they appear in the list but do not collide with the 5 demo BCs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All v3.2 endpoints are live and seeded under /api/v3/*. Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_v3_backend.py is robust to repeat runs (dynamically picks non-approved deliverables). MTN BC (bc-mtn-burna) has feedback applied by these tests, raising its closure_pct to 100%; do not assume it's still at 75. Test BCs are intentionally left in the DB.
rca of the issue: Initial single test failure on deliverable transition was due to seed-state drift across runs (del-nb-5 had already been advanced by prior dev usage). Mitigation: test now selects the first non-approved deliverable dynamically rather than hardcoding del-nb-5.
